sources: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL): waterway/man_made=dam, water=reservoir / natural=water, place, waterway=river names; scope Tunisia (Overpass area ISO3166-1=TN)
HydroBASINS v1c level 12 and HydroRIVERS v1.0 (Lehner & Grill 2013, WWF / McGill), 15 arc-second SRTM hydrology
NISAR L2 GCOV product footprints, ASF search inventory 17 Jun – 31 Oct 2026
method: Dam = OSM dam feature with a dam name (Barrage / سد) or an OSM reservoir polygon ≥ 0.2 km² within 500 m; one entry per reservoir. Crest point = dam-line midpoint. Snapped to the nearest main-stem HydroRIVERS reach within 3 km (upland ≥ 0.5 × local max); catchment = that reach's HydroBASINS lev-12 unit + all units draining to it (dissolved, simplified ~150 m); downstream path = HydroRIVERS NEXT_DOWN chain from the crest to the sea / an endorheic sink / the national border / the next catalogued dam (simplified ~100 m). Towns = OSM places within 2 km of the path (Tunisia). NISAR = distinct GCOV acquisition dates whose product footprint contains the crest point.
uncertainty: HydroSHEDS is a 500 m-scale model network: catchments include the whole lev-12 unit at the outlet (can over-count small dams), paths differ from OSM rivers by up to a few hundred metres and from our 30 m D8 path in length. OSM coverage and names are incomplete; null = not in the sources. Reservoir area is the mapped polygon, not current storage.
tunisia_bbox_note: Tunisia (geoBoundaries ADM0) extended to every catalogued dam, incl. --extra dams abroad
